# National Harm Reduction Coalition

> > National Harm Reduction Coalition (NHRC) provides training, resources, and advocacy for harm reduction programs including overdose prevention, syringe access, pregnancy and substance use support, and community health initiatives.

NHRC operates major initiatives including the California Overdose Prevention and Harm Reduction Initiative (COPHRI), HepConnect for HCV prevention, and ongoing webinar series like Foundational Fridays. The organization serves harm reduction practitioners, birth workers, sex workers, and people who use drugs across California, New York, Appalachia, and nationally.

## Key Topics

- Harm reduction principles and practice
- Overdose prevention and naloxone distribution
- Fentanyl and opioid crisis response
- Syringe access and safer injection
- Pregnancy and substance use
- Hepatitis C (HCV) prevention and treatment
- LGBTQ+ and TGNC health equity
- Sex work decriminalization and services
- Medications for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD)
- California Overdose Prevention and Harm Reduction Initiative (COPHRI)
- Community capacity building and mobilization
- Birth worker training and support
- Black and Latino MSM health
- Needlestick protocols and safety

## Core Training & Webinar Series

- [Foundational Fridays – Harm Reduction 101](https://harmreduction.org/events/foundational-fridays-harm-reduction-101): Introductory harm reduction training webinar for service providers
- [Fentanyl and Harm Reduction Strategies](https://harmreduction.org/issues/fentanyl/harm-reduction-strategies-webinar): Free webinar on fentanyl overdose prevention and harm reduction practices
- [Foundational Fridays- LGB/TGNC 101](https://harmreduction.org/events/foundational-fridays-lgb-tgnc-101-2): LGBTQ+ health disparities and inclusive services training webinar
- [Foundational Fridays – Sex Work 101](https://harmreduction.org/events/foundational-fridays-sex-work-101-469): Training on sex work, decriminalization, and service accessibility
- [Safer injection 201](https://harmreduction.org/events/safer-injection-201): Advanced training on safer injection practices and communication skills
- [Lighthouse Learning Series: Sex Work 101](https://harmreduction.org/events/lighthouse-learning-series-sex-work-101): Sex work advocacy training with HIPS and NHRC facilitators

## Pregnancy & Substance Use Resources

- [Pregnancy and Substance Use Office Hours: Toolkit Launch](https://harmreduction.org/events/pregnancy-and-substance-use-office-hours-toolkit-launch): Launch event for NHRC pregnancy and substance use harm reduction toolkit
- [Pregnancy and Substance Use Office Hours: Birth Workers Session](https://harmreduction.org/events/pregnancy-and-substance-use-birth-workers-session): Office hours webinar for birth workers on pregnancy and substance use
- [Pregnancy and Substance Use Office Hours: Programs On the Ground](https://harmreduction.org/events/pregnancy-and-substance-use-office-hours-programs-on-the-ground): Office hours featuring pregnancy and substance use programs in practice

## Technical Reference & Program Guides

- [Appendix H: Needlestick Protocols](https://harmreduction.org/issues/syringe-access/guide-to-managing-programs/appendix-h-needlestick-protocols): Needlestick protocols and post-exposure prophylaxis for syringe programs
- [Potential Health Complications of Injection Drug Use](https://harmreduction.org/issues/safer-drug-use/injection-safety-manual/potential-health-injections): Reference guide on injection drug use health complications and infections

## Research & Reports

- [Supporting Black & Latino MSM Who Use Crystal Meth: Overview](https://harmreduction.org/issues/safer-drug-use/supporting-black-latino-msm-who-use-crystal-meth-report/overview): Research report on Black and Latino MSM crystal meth use experiences
- [HepConnect: From Project Launch to Grant Awards](https://harmreduction.org/issues/hepatitis-c/hepconnect-initiative-report): HepConnect Initiative report on HCV prevention in Appalachia region

## CHRI Learning Collaborative

- [CHRI Learning Collaborative MOUD Mini Series - Session #3, MOUD Partner Panel](https://harmreduction.org/events/chri-learning-collaborative-moud-mini-series-session-3-moud-partner-panel): MOUD partner panel session in CHRI learning collaborative series
- [CHRI Learning Collaborative- Development and Individual Giving](https://harmreduction.org/events/development-giving): Fundraising and donor engagement training for CHRI collaborative members
